Title: What is the cheapest flooring for a rental property?
Description: Sheet vinyl is the cheapest installed option in the guides we read, at about $1 to $4 per square foot, or roughly $600 to $2,400 for 600 sq ft. Laminate and budget carpet follow at about $3 to $8. Stained concrete can also be cheap if a good slab is already there. Cheapest upfront does not always mean cheapest per year. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How much does vinyl plank flooring cost per square foot?
Description: Cost guides put the planks at about $2 to $7 per square foot, and installed at roughly $3.50 to $11. In November 2026 we saw Floor & Decor listings from $0.99 for a thin glue-down plank to $3.49 for a 6 mm click-lock plank with a pad. Luxury and rigid-core lines run higher in the guides. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How much does it cost to paint a ceiling?
Description: A plain ceiling costs about $1.37–$3 per square foot for a professional, or roughly $200–$500 for a typical room, in two 2026 guides. Popcorn, vaulted and water-damaged ceilings run $2–$5 per square foot. Doing it yourself costs $20–$70 per gallon of paint, plus about $40–$90 for a basic 12x12 kit. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How much does it cost to paint a 12x12 room?
Description: Professionals quote $200-$450 (ThePaintCalculator) to $400-$900 (Facade Colorizer) for the walls of a 12x12 room, with one guide that does not name its sources going far higher. DIY, paint runs $55-$100 per ThePaintCalculator, and adding $50-$100 of supplies gives about $105-$200 (our arithmetic). Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: Is luxury vinyl plank worth it for a rental?
Description: For most units, yes, based on the sources. LVP installs at about $4 to $9 per square foot in 2026 guides, resists water, and lets you replace one plank. One landlord guide puts its life at 10 to 15 years in an active rental. Choose a wear layer of at least 20 mil and verify the product and subfloor requirements before buying. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: Is it cheaper to install vinyl plank myself?
Description: Yes, by the cost of labor, which is $1.50 to $10 per square foot depending on the guide. On our 180 sq ft example that is about $270 to $1,800. Tools, prep mistakes and wasted planks can eat into the saving, and This Old House suggests a professional for glue-down. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: Is it cheaper to paint a ceiling or walls?
Description: Per square foot, a flat ceiling is usually the same or cheaper than walls: $1.37–$3 here against $2–$6 for interior painting in a 2022 guide. A room's ceiling is also smaller than its wall area. The exceptions are high, vaulted, textured and stained ceilings, where one guide says vaulted work can cost about 50% more. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: Is it cheaper to paint a room myself?
Description: Yes, because labor is 75-85% of a professional bill in Facade Colorizer's breakdown. The trade-off is time: that guide estimates 8-12 hours for you against 3-5 for a pro on an average room, and a first-timer should allow a full weekend once taping and drying are counted. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.
